data.name: The Last E.L.I.T.E.s
data.detailed_description:
The Agency Fell. The Mission Didn't.
You are Agent Scuddler Thompson, a former Navy SEAL and top operative for the E.L.I.T.E. Division. For years, this covert agency operated outside government control to dismantle global threats from the shadows. But golden ages do not last. Fractured by intelligence leaks and an internal conspiracy, the agency has collapsed.

Now, you are a fugitive hunted by the very world you swore to protect. You must rebuild your network from the ashes, determine which of your former comrades can still be trusted, and uncover the truth.

Define Your Legacy
Experience a deep, branching narrative where every decision matters. Every dialogue choice, bullet fired, and life spared ripples through the story, impacting both immediate outcomes and long-term consequences. Justice restores balance and builds a future; revenge fuels a cycle of destruction. Will you uphold the law, or will you burn it all down to get to the truth?

Tactical Realism
Powered by the Unity 6 engine, The Last E.L.I.T.E.s delivers a grounded tactical shooter experience. Run and gun tactics will get you killed. Success requires planning, precise execution, and mastering realistic ballistics in destructible environments. Experience true immersion with a minimal user interface where sound and instinct are your best tools.

Global Online Warfare
Team up or compete against players worldwide in high-stakes 7v7 online modes and cooperative missions.

  • Hostage Rescue: Execute precision breaches to rescue captives, or lock down the perimeter to prevent the opposing team from securing them.

  • Bodyguard: Coordinate with your squad to protect a high value target, or plan an ambush to eliminate them.

  • Ranked and Casual TDM: Test your tactical abilities against other agents worldwide. Climb the seasonal leaderboards to earn exclusive rewards and secure your legacy.

  • PvE Raids: Join forces with friends to overcome challenging cooperative objectives against advanced AI.

  • Proximity Voice Chat: Communicate with allies or taunt enemies. Sound is a weapon, use it wisely to coordinate or deceive.

  • Seasonal Events: Keep the battlefield fresh with limited time game modes, unique challenges, and seasonal rewards.

High-Tech Arsenal and Fair Economy
Unlock and master a diverse arsenal, from reliable M4A1s and AK variants to specialized E.L.I.T.E. issued sidearms. Utilize cutting edge tactical equipment like EM Wall Sensors, Jammers, Surveillance Drones, and Airstrikes to gain the upper hand.

Everything you use is earned through skill. Unlock weapons and gear purely with in-game credits. There are absolutely no pay to win mechanics.

About Infinity Productions AB
We are a small, dedicated Swedish indie-studio with one goal: to create the games we want to play ourselves. Driven by passion and a shared vision, we are working hard to deliver an impactful, high-quality experience that resonates worldwide. The Last E.L.I.T.E.s is just the beginning.

Are you ready for the challenge? Join our community on Discord and help shape the fight for the future of E.L.I.T.E.

data.short_description: Step into the shadows as Scuddler Thompson, a former Navy SEAL and fugitive of the fallen E.L.I.T.E. Division. Navigate a world of chaos, engage in tactical multiplayer, and make high-stakes choices. Will you restore justice or seek revenge? Every decision shapes your legacy.

content_descriptors.notes:
For The Last E.L.I.T.E.s, we want players to know that our game includes mature content intended for a mature audience. The game contains frequent depictions of intense action and violence, including combat situations with firearms, explosives, and close-quarters combat. Violence is central to the gameplay and is depicted realistically within the narrative context of an elite agent facing dangerous opponents.

While there are no depictions of sexual acts, themes of corruption and betrayal, as well as scenes depicting crime, terrorism, and political intrigue, are core elements of the storyline. The game may also include references to alcohol use and mild language.

We aim to approach these themes with respect to the narrative and to provide a challenging yet thoughtful experience. If any of these elements may be sensitive for you, please take them into consideration before playing.
